title: G16 · 接受
body: I isolated two changes while preserving the six proven champion kernels: word-frequency counting now uses stable token IDs and packed counters without changing the validated cutoff ordering, and matrix multiplication now uses representation-specific 2×2 tiles with eight-way k unrolling while retaining transposed B and exact k-order accumulation. Gen 15’s measured matrix factor was about 1.42×, so even a conservative 1.10× word-frequency gain should exceed the 5% aggregate threshold; removing repeated Map writes and shrinking the frequency bucket should provide additional margin. I left topK, prime mapping, and all other proven algorithms untouched to avoid the prior correctness failures.
